editorial_review.character_consistency: Stripe and its pair share the identical design, distinguished only by the pink heart darn; the pigeon is consistent across SC5-8.
editorial_review.story_originality: Socks as migratory birds; unique premise.
editorial_review.scene_continuity: Same evening throughout - laundromat dusk -> rooftop dusk -> sea -> island sunset (moving south and west keeps the sun up).
editorial_review.visual_quality: Signature frames - dryer launch (SC1), clothesline snag (SC4), sock scarf on a pigeon (SC7), sock island (SC9), sock ball (SC11).
editorial_review.animation_feasibility: Socks are simple ribbon shapes; the flock reuses one undulation cycle with offsets.
editorial_review.pacing: Loss at 3s, journey 7.5-34s, arrival 34s, lonely beat 39s, twist last 5s.
editorial_review.sound_sync: Flock theme reserved for SC1 and SC8 to mark loss and return.
editorial_review.strong_opening: Socks flying out of a dryer in formation.
editorial_review.memorable_ending: Stripe finds its matching pair and they roll into a sock ball.
